topic: Sukuna took Megumi's body for Mahoraga, the one shikigami that could adapt to Gojo
title: Why Sukuna Needed Megumi's Body To Beat Gojo
description: Sukuna had Yuji's body and still wanted Megumi's. Here's why the Ten Shadows Technique, and Mahoraga in particular, was the answer to Gojo's Infinity. Do you agree?
comment: Did Sukuna win because of Megumi's technique, or would he have beaten Gojo anyway? Pick one.
pages: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga

lines.text: Sukuna had Yuji's body. So why did he take Megumi's?

shot.fallback: dark curse king in a boy's body

lines.text: Everyone says it's because Megumi is stronger. I don't buy that.

shot.fallback: spiky haired student with ominous marks

lines.text: I think Sukuna wanted exactly one thing from him.
The Ten Shadows Technique, because it hides Mahoraga.

shot.fallback: eight armed wheel above a pale giant

lines.text: Mahoraga adapts to any attack, so the same attack never works twice.

shot.fallback: golden wheel spinning above a giant

lines.text: And in the whole history of that technique, only Sukuna ever tamed him.

shot.fallback: king of curses facing a divine general

lines.text: Now picture Gojo. His Infinity stops everything, and his Unlimited Void is supposed to win on contact.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a galaxy domain

lines.text: Yuji's body can't answer that. Megumi's can.

shot.fallback: two sorcerers clashing over a ruined city

lines.text: In Shinjuku, Mahoraga adapted to the domain and destroyed Unlimited Void within seconds.

shot.fallback: giant slicing through a shattering domain

lines.text: Gojo's best technique, undone by a vessel Sukuna borrowed from a kid.
So here's my read: it was never about the body.
Sukuna had Yuji's body. So why did he take Megumi's?

shot.fallback: dark curse king in a boy's body
